For more information and to order stereo imagery products, please refer to the GEO Stereo Imagery Order Form.

  • Time of Capture: April 18th 2008 - November 7th 2008, and April 15th 2009 - November 17th 2009 
  • Number of Frames: 48,051 frames 
  • Resolution: 20 centimetre (RGB)
  • Bit-depth: 16-bit 
  • Number of bands: Three band (RGB) (also available in PAN and NRG)
  • Format: TIFF (ISAT AT model setup) 

For more information on the Digital Raster Acquisition Project Eastern Ontario (DRAPE) 2008 please see the main DRAPE 2008 GeoHub record. 

 
Available Products: 
Stereo Frames 
  • Digital Raster Acquisition Project Eastern Ontario (DRAPE) 2008 - Stereo Frames and associated AT Models 

Contact Ontario Ministry of Natural Resources - Geospatial Ontario, imagery@ontario.ca
